summary: Agents retain access to shell executions from earlier live invocations after claiming work in the same harness incarnation.

replay.detail: Existing native invocation receipts and execution ownership are read directly; nothing is replayed or rebuilt.

schema.detail: No storage, client schema or wire format changes.

rules.detail: Execution ownership and invocation receipts are written as before.

compatibility.detail: Agent execution reads, lists, waits, cancellation and request lookup accept any live invocation of the current incarnation. Other agents, ended invocations and other incarnations remain isolated. Run credentials retain exact step-attempt scope.
